note: Concerning Dan he said: 'Dan is a lion's cub, leaping out of Bashan.' (Deuteronomy 33:22), as Jacob says of Judah (Genesis 49:9).

'chased away by lions. The first to devour him was the king of Assyria; the last to crush his bones was Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon' (Jer 50:17); the other lion, the king of Assyria, has no record.
'Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour' (1Pet 5:8). Replaces the existing edge, which points at the creature `lion`.
'the people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion' (Num 23:24).
'He crouches, he lies down like a lion, like a lioness' (Num 24:9); the 'he' is Israel by the oracle's run.
'Blessed is he who enlarges the domain of Gad! He lies down like a lion' (Deut 33:20).
'Like a lion roaring or a young lion over its prey ... so the LORD of Hosts will come down to do battle on Mount Zion' (Isa 31:4).
'Like a lion He breaks all my bones' (Isa 38:13).
'For I am like a lion to Ephraim and like a young lion to the house of Judah' (Hos 5:14).
'So like a lion I will pounce on them' (Hos 13:7); 'I will devour them like a lion' (Hos 13:8).
'He has left His den like a lion' (Jer 25:38).
'My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest' (Jer 12:8); the inheritance is Israel (12:7).
'They will roar together like young lions' (Jer 51:38), after 'Babylon will become a heap of rubble' (51:37).
'this uncircumcised Philistine will be like one of them' (1Sam 17:36), the lions and bears David has killed.
